maintenance_led.reason: Mostly new railcar manufacturing at Castaños, Mexico plant; parts, rebodies and conversions are the smaller part.

publicly_funded.reason: Buyers are railcar lessors, railroads and shippers, which are private businesses, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by manufacturing and selling its own railcars; no pattern of regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Railcars are bought by order from several competing builders; customers can switch builders between orders without heavy disruption.

notes: Revenue mix is judged from general knowledge of the company; the website gives no figures.
